lines.start: The vial goes into the resequencer. Two hours, and either a familiar face or a very expensive smell.
lines.success: The tank clears. It is unmistakably the same animal, blinking at a world that graduated it.
lines.successMutated: The tank clears — and something is different this time.
lines.failure: The resequencer produces a sound nobody has heard before and then produces nothing at all. The vial is spent. Science is like that.
lines.cancel: Resequencer drained. The vial went back in the rack, no worse for the experience.
lines.penFull: It is ready to decant and there is nowhere to put it. Free a pen and come back — nothing is lost while it waits.
artefactGene: Resequencing artefact: a {trait} gene that was not in the sample. The lab denies responsibility.
Resequencing artefact: the {trait} gene, arriving uninvited and settling in.
Unscheduled {trait} expression. The sample did not have this. It does now.
artefactStat: Resequencing artefact: a spontaneous {stat} surge. Nobody planned this.
Resequencing artefact: {stat} has come back higher than it went in. No notes were taken.
The {stat} readings are up and the machine is refusing to explain itself.
